about.story: BERO Upholstery Studio is a family-run workshop with over 20 years of experience in the craft of upholstery. We specialise in the restoration and creation of upholstered furniture, combining traditional craftsmanship with modern solutions.
about.mission: We restore furniture to its unique character and full functionality. Every project is approached individually, with the highest level of care and attention to detail.
about.services.renovationDesc: We bring furniture back to life, enhancing its original character
about.services.upholsteryDesc: We give furniture a new look with carefully selected fabrics
about.services.repairDesc: We reinforce structures to ensure durability and comfort
about.services.automotiveDesc: We restore vehicle interiors, bringing back elegance and comfort
